questions.question: Which of the following articles in the Indian Constitution deals with the Fundamental Duties of citizens?
questions.explanation: Article 51A enlists Fundamental Duties of citizens.

questions.question: How many sessions of the West Bengal Legislative Assembly can be summoned by the Governor within a period of six months?
questions.explanation: Up to 8 sessions can be summoned by the Governor within a period of six months.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Panchayati Raj system in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Panchayati Raj system in West Bengal is Three-tier.

questions.question: Who among the following is the head of the State Election Commission in West Bengal?
options: Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court
questions.explanation: The State Election Commissioner is the head of the State Election Commission in West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the name of the scheme launched by the West Bengal Government to provide free bicycles to girl students?
questions.explanation: Sabuj Sathi is the scheme launched by the West Bengal Government to provide free bicycles to girl students.

questions.question: The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta is located in which part of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It is located in the Sundarbans.

questions.question: Which mountain range passes through the state of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It passes through the Northeastern Hills.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers is not a major tributary of the Hooghly River?
questions.explanation: Kangsabati is a tributary of the Subarnarekha River.

questions.question: Which of the following cities is the administrative headquarters of the Darjeeling district?
questions.explanation: Darjeeling is the administrative headquarters.

questions.question: Which of the following is a notable wetland in the Sundarbans region of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Sajnekhali Wetland is a notable wetland.

questions.question: The 13th Finance Commission has recently recommended a higher share of funds for West Bengal, which is likely to help the state address its revenue gap. This recommendation is based on the state's _______________?
questions.explanation: The recommendation is based on the state's tax revenue.

questions.question: The recently inaugurated _______________ in Kolkata aims to promote sustainable urban living and reduce the city's carbon footprint.
questions.explanation: The Green City Hub is the recently inaugurated project.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has recently launched an initiative to provide financial assistance to farmers affected by the recent floods. The initiative is being implemented through the _______________ scheme.
options: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
questions.explanation: The initiative is being implemented through the Mukhya Mantri Krishi Aarthik Sahayata Yojana scheme.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has recently signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the _______________ to promote economic cooperation and development in the state.
questions.explanation: The West Bengal government has recently signed an MoU with the Odisha Government.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has recently launched a campaign to promote digital literacy among the rural population. The campaign is being implemented through the _______________ initiative.
questions.explanation: The campaign is being implemented through the Mukhya Mantri Digital Abhyan initiative.

questions.question: Under which scheme of the West Bengal government, financial assistance is provided to the families of police personnel who die in the line of duty?
questions.explanation: Karmachari Kalyan Yojana provides financial assistance to the families of police personnel who die in the line of duty.

questions.question: Which of the following is a flagship programme of the West Bengal government for providing free healthcare services to the citizens?
questions.explanation: Swasthya Sathi Yojana provides free healthcare services to the citizens.

questions.question: What is the name of the West Bengal government's initiative to promote education among the girl child?
questions.explanation: Kanyashree Prakalpa is the West Bengal government's initiative to promote education among the girl child.

questions.question: Under which scheme of the West Bengal government, bicycles are provided to school-going children?
questions.explanation: Sabooj Sathi Yojana provides bicycles to school-going children.

questions.question: Which of the following is a scholarship scheme of the West Bengal government for meritorious students?
questions.explanation: Siksha Sathi Yojana is a scholarship scheme of the West Bengal government for meritorious students.

questions.question: At a certain bank in West Bengal, the compound interest (CI) for 2 years on Rs. 10,000 at 8% p.a. rate is calculated as Rs. 1,664. Then what is the simple interest (SI) for the same period?
questions.explanation: Simple interest is calculated using the formula SI = (P * R * T) / 100.

questions.question: A man borrowed Rs. 12,000 from a local moneylender in Kolkata at an interest rate of 12% p.a. for 3 years. What is the total amount he has to pay at the end of 3 years?
questions.explanation: The total amount includes the principal amount plus the simple interest.

questions.question: If an amount of Rs. 5,000 is invested at 10% per annum compound interest for 2 years, what is the amount at the end of 2 years?
questions.explanation: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt).

questions.question: A person deposits Rs. 8,000 in a fixed deposit account at 9% p.a. simple interest for 5 years. How much interest will he receive at the end of 5 years?
questions.explanation: The interest is calculated using the formula SI = (P * R * T) / 100.

questions.question: A bank in Siliguri offers a compound interest (CI) of Rs. 1,368 on an amount of Rs. 7,000 at a rate of 8% p.a. for 2 years. What is the rate of interest on this investment?
questions.explanation: The formula to calculate compound interest is A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt).

questions.question: A train travels from Sealdah to Howrah, a distance of 15 km in 30 minutes. What is the speed of the train in km per hour?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated by dividing distance by time.

questions.question: A car travels from Kolkata to Durgapur, a distance of 170 km in 5 hours. What is the average speed of the car in km per hour?
questions.explanation: Average speed is calculated by dividing total distance by total time.

questions.question: A bus travels from Esplanade to Barrackpore, a distance of 28 km in 1 hour. What is the difference between the average speed of the bus and the speed limit of NH 12?
questions.explanation: Since the bus's speed is equal to the speed limit, the difference is 0.

questions.question: A man covers a distance of 48 km in 8 hours. What is the time taken by him to cover a distance of 72 km?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated by dividing distance by speed.

questions.question: A bus travels from Bidhan Nagar to Barasat, a distance of 32 km in 2 hours. What is the time taken by the bus to cover a distance of 32 km at the same speed?
questions.explanation: Time is calculated as distance divided by speed.

questions.question: If 'B' is called 'A', 'A' is called 'C', 'C' is called 'D', then what would be called 'B'?
questions.explanation: This is a direct reverse relation.

questions.question: In a series 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, what comes next?
questions.explanation: Each term increases by 3.

questions.question: If 'DOG' is called 'CAT', 'CAT' is called 'ELEPHANT', then what would be called 'DOG'?
questions.explanation: This is a direct replacement relation.

questions.question: If 2 is called 5, 5 is called 8, 8 is called 11, then what would be called 2?
questions.explanation: This is a direct replacement relation.

questions.question: If 1 is called 2, 2 is called 3, 3 is called 4, then what would be called 1?
questions.explanation: This is a direct replacement relation.

questions.question: If P is the mother of R, and R is the son of S, then what is the relationship between S and P?
questions.explanation: P is the grandmother of S.

questions.question: If S is the father of T, and T is the son of U, then what is the relationship between S and U?
questions.explanation: S is the grandfather of U.

questions.question: If A is the husband of B, and C is the daughter of B, then what is the relationship between A and C?
questions.explanation: A is the son-in-law of B.

questions.question: If D is the mother of E, and E is the daughter of F, then what is the relationship between D and F?
questions.explanation: D is the grandmother of F.

questions.question: If G is the brother of H, and H is the son of I, then what is the relationship between G and I?
questions.explanation: G is the uncle of H.

questions.question: If you are in the Howrah Bridge and face the city, which direction will you be facing if you turn 135 degrees to your left?
questions.explanation: Turning 135 degrees to the left from the direction facing the city will result in facing the west direction.

questions.question: If it takes 5 hours to reach the destination from Bardhaman and 3 hours to return, what is the total time taken for a round trip?
questions.explanation: Total time taken for a round trip is the sum of the time taken to reach the destination and the time taken to return.

questions.question: If you walk 20 km in 5 hours and then walk at the same speed for another 2 hours, how far would you have walked in total?
questions.explanation: Distance walked in the last 2 hours is calculated by multiplying the speed by the time taken.

questions.question: If it is 9 AM in Siliguri, what will be the time 5 hours and 30 minutes later?
questions.explanation: Adding 5 hours and 30 minutes to 9 AM results in 2:30 PM.

questions.question: If you walk 2 km in the north direction and then 3 km in the south direction, what is the net distance walked in the north direction?
questions.explanation: Net distance walked in the north direction is the initial distance walked in the north direction minus the distance walked in the south direction.

questions.question: In a series of numbers, each term is obtained by adding 4 to the previous term. Which of the following numbers will be the 8th term in the series starting from 13?
questions.explanation: The 8th term in the series starting from 13 is 21.

questions.question: In a series of alphabets, each term is obtained by shifting the previous term 2 positions to the right in the English alphabet. Which of the following alphabets will be the 5th term in the series starting from 'R'?
questions.explanation: The 5th term in the series starting from 'R' is 'T'.

questions.question: In a series of numbers, each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by 3. Which of the following numbers will be the 6th term in the series starting from 4?
questions.explanation: The 6th term in the series starting from 4 is 2160.

questions.question: In a series of alphabets, each term is obtained by shifting the previous term 3 positions to the left in the English alphabet. Which of the following alphabets will be the 4th term in the series starting from 'Z'?
questions.explanation: The 4th term in the series starting from 'Z' is 'X'.

questions.question: In a series of numbers, each term is obtained by adding 2 to the previous term. If the first term is 5 and the seventh term is 21, how many terms are there in the series?
questions.explanation: There are 8 terms in the series.
